"""Independent stdlib verification of the actual one-shot exit acquisition."""
import argparse
from decimal import Decimal
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import sys
import zipfile

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--root',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--evidence',type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
root,evidence=args.root,args.evidence
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from verify_sealed_historical_management_exit_acquisition_registration_v01 import check, read, same, require, digest, canonical

ID='sealed-historical-management-exit-acquisition-v0.1'
EXEC='887f4a08f2cf6279c80d8aee8476ce9ae7da8b52'
TREE='d8ecbaf19c2acfc77172c70a15f08977e85891a1'
CODE='98531d5f7d52cb0641de36573da93479a7c1b7eb'
CODE_TREE='68e82175628f5a85e7b0a470a14fcb64684c37f1'
RUN=34172486163
github=json.loads((evidence/'github-evidence.json').read_text())
run=github['run']
for key,value in {'id':RUN,'head_sha':EXEC,'head_branch':'phase-3-historical-snapshot',
                  'event':'push','run_attempt':1,'status':'completed',
                  'path':'.github/workflows/sealed-historical-management-exit-acquisition-v01.yml'}.items():
    same(run[key],value)
require(run['conclusion'] in {'success','failure'},'unexpected terminal state')
commit=github['execution_commit']
same(commit['sha'],EXEC);same(commit['tree']['sha'],TREE)
same([p['sha'] for p in commit['parents']],[CODE])
same(github['consumption_ref']['ref'],'refs/tags/'+ID+'-consumed')
same(github['consumption_ref']['object']['sha'],EXEC)
contract=read(root/f'research/strategy/{ID}.json')
protected={item['ref'][5:]:item['object']['sha'] for item in [github['main'],*github['prior_consumed_refs']]}
same(protected,contract['immutable_refs'])
archives={}
for kind in ('consumption','result'):
    path=evidence/(kind+'.zip')
    matches=[item for item in github['artifacts'] if item['name']==f'sealed-historical-management-exit-input-v01-{kind}-{RUN}-1']
    same(len(matches),1);artifact=matches[0]
    same(artifact['expired'],False);same(artifact['workflow_run']['id'],RUN)
    same(artifact['size_in_bytes'],path.stat().st_size)
    same(artifact['digest'],'sha256:'+digest(path.read_bytes()))
    files={}
    destination=evidence/kind
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        for item in archive.infolist():
            name=PurePosixPath(item.filename)
            require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and str(name)==item.filename,'unsafe archive path')
            require(not item.is_dir() and ((item.external_attr>>16)&0o170000)!=0o120000,'nonregular archive entry')
            require(item.filename not in files,'duplicate archive member')
            raw=archive.read(item)
            require(raw==(destination/item.filename).read_bytes(),'extracted archive bytes differ')
            files[item.filename]={'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':digest(raw)}
    actual={p.relative_to(destination).as_posix() for p in destination.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    same(sorted(actual),sorted(files))
    archives[kind]={'artifact_id':artifact['id'],'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(path.read_bytes()),'files':files}
output=evidence/'result';pre=evidence/'consumption'
for name in ('quote-consumption.zip','quote-result.zip','execution.json','contract.json','consumption.json','environment.json','parent-verification.json'):
    same(digest((pre/name).read_bytes()),digest((output/name).read_bytes()))
same(digest((output/'execution.json').read_bytes()),digest((root/f'research/strategy/{ID}-execution.json').read_bytes()))
same(digest((output/'contract.json').read_bytes()),digest((root/f'research/strategy/{ID}.json').read_bytes()))
execution,marker=read(output/'execution.json'),read(output/'consumption.json')
same((execution['code_commit_sha'],execution['code_tree_sha']),(CODE,CODE_TREE))
same(execution['workflow_file_sha256'],digest((root/execution['workflow_path']).read_bytes()))
same((marker['execution_commit_sha'],marker['workflow_run_id'],marker['workflow_run_attempt']),(EXEC,str(RUN),1))
same(marker['execution_content_sha256'],execution['content_sha256'])
report=read(output/'capture-report.json')
same(report['provenance'],{'execution_commit_sha':EXEC,'workflow_run_id':str(RUN),'workflow_run_attempt':1,
    'code_commit_sha':CODE,'code_tree_sha':CODE_TREE,'execution_content_sha256':execution['content_sha256'],
    'consumption_content_sha256':marker['content_sha256']})
pins=dict(re.findall(r'^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)==([^\s\\]+)',(root/contract['requirements_path']).read_text(),re.M))
env=read(output/'environment.json')
same(env['implementation'],'CPython');same(env['python_version'],'3.12.14');same(env['package_versions'],pins)
same(env['requirements_sha256'],contract['requirements_sha256'])
limits=read(root/f'research/runtime/{ID}/request-limits.json')['request_limits']
requests=[row['request'] for row in limits]
calls=read(output/'metadata-ledger.json')['calls']
metadata=read(output/'metadata-http-ledger.json');timeseries=read(output/'timeseries-http-ledger.json')
for ledger,ceiling,forbidden in ((metadata,160,'non_metadata_calls'),(timeseries,80,'unregistered_endpoint_calls')):
    for field in ('http_attempts','blocked_attempts','automatic_retries','redirects_followed',forbidden):
        require(type(ledger[field]) is int and ledger[field]>=0,'noninteger HTTP ledger')
    require(ledger['http_attempts']<=ceiling,'HTTP cap exceeded')
    same(ledger['http_attempts'],len(ledger['attempts']))
    for field in ('automatic_retries','redirects_followed',forbidden):same(ledger[field],0)
    for i,attempt in enumerate(ledger['attempts']):same(attempt['ordinal'],i+1)
same(report['http_attempts'],metadata['http_attempts']+timeseries['http_attempts'])
same(report['blocked_attempts'],metadata['blocked_attempts']+timeseries['blocked_attempts'])
requote=read(output/'requote-report.json') if (output/'requote-report.json').exists() else None
if requote is not None:
    same(requote['calls'],calls)
    for i,call in enumerate(calls):
        request=requests[i//2];method=('get_billable_size','get_cost')[i%2]
        same((call['ordinal'],call['request_id'],call['method'],call['request_content_sha256']),
             (i+1,request['request_id'],method,digest(canonical(request))))
        if i<len(metadata['attempts']):
            attempt=metadata['attempts'][i]
            same((attempt['request_id'],attempt['method']),(request['request_id'],method))
            if call['status']=='success':same((attempt['status'],attempt['http_status']),('success',200))
    if requote['preflight_passed']:
        same((len(calls),metadata['http_attempts'],metadata['blocked_attempts']),(160,160,0))
        sizes=[];costs=[]
        for i,limit in enumerate(limits):
            size,cost=calls[2*i],calls[2*i+1]
            same((size['status'],cost['status']),('success','success'))
            require(type(size['value']) is int and 0<size['value']<=limit['maximum_billable_bytes'],'individual size cap')
            require(Decimal(cost['value']).is_finite() and 0<=Decimal(cost['value'])<=Decimal(limit['maximum_quoted_cost_usd']),'individual cost cap')
            same(requote['quote_rows'][i],{'request_id':requests[i]['request_id'],'billable_size_bytes':size['value'],
                'quoted_cost_usd':cost['value'],'within_original_ceiling':True})
            sizes.append(size['value']);costs.append(Decimal(cost['value']))
        same(requote['total_billable_bytes'],sum(sizes))
        same(requote['total_quoted_cost_usd'],format(sum(costs,Decimal(0)),'f'))
        require(sum(sizes)<=209898320 and sum(costs)<=Decimal('0.234732925899'),'aggregate quote cap')
if timeseries['attempts']:require(requote is not None and requote['preflight_passed'] is True,'downloads before complete quote')
for i,attempt in enumerate(timeseries['attempts']):
    same((attempt['request_id'],attempt['request_content_sha256'],attempt['method']),
         (requests[i]['request_id'],digest(canonical(requests[i])),'timeseries.get_range'))
    same(attempt['maximum_wire_bytes'],limits[i]['maximum_wire_bytes'])
    require(type(attempt['wire_bytes']) is int and attempt['wire_bytes']>=0,'wire counter')
    if report['requests'][i]['status'] in ('complete','unavailable'):
        same((attempt['status'],attempt['http_status']),('complete',200))
        require(0<attempt['wire_bytes']<=limits[i]['maximum_wire_bytes'],'wire cap')
        same(attempt['wire_bytes'],report['requests'][i]['native']['wire_bytes'])
result=check(root,output,output)
same(report['original_source_provider_requests'],30522)
same(report['runtime_input_eligible'],False)
same(report['actual_billing_known'],False)
same(report['original_entry_inputs_changed'],False)
if report['request_evidence_complete']:
    same(run['conclusion'],'success');same(report['error'],None)
    same((metadata['http_attempts'],timeseries['http_attempts'],report['blocked_attempts']),(160,80,0))
    same(report['raw_temp_directory_removed'],True)
    same(len(report['requests']),80)
result.update({'actual_capture_provenance_verified':True,'archives':archives,
    'execution_commit_sha':EXEC,'workflow_run_id':RUN,'requote_total_billable_bytes':None if requote is None else requote['total_billable_bytes'],
    'requote_total_quoted_cost_usd':None if requote is None else requote['total_quoted_cost_usd'],
    'complete_quote_precedes_downloads':True,'raw_dbn_retained':False,'verification_provider_calls':0})
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
